text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers envelop the victor. Standing at 
their center is <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved results more than 
sufficient as a prelude, next is finally 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe— The title 
of world's best is now right before her 
eyes.
